reason: A Web UI customization plugin that displays a draggable SVG water-ball pet whose appearance reflects Agent session states and can be configured through plugin settings.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中显示可拖动、可配置的漂浮 SVG 水球宠物，并根据 Agent 会话状态变化呈现不同动画与颜色。
summaries.en: Displays a draggable, configurable SVG water-ball pet in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that changes color and animation with Agent session states.

capabilities: renders a floating SVG pet overlay in the Web UI
listens to DeepSeek Harness session and optional activity status events
provides settings for visibility, size, position, and eye appearance
exposes a waterball status endpoint for the browser portion
